selection: All eight public development candidates, latest eight reachable two-parent merges with a unique merge-base strictly different from both parents and a Python source change, ordered by descending committer timestamp then SHA; no oracle or detector outcome enters selection. Every selected case and exclusion is retained. If fewer than five repositories are eligible, preregister a separate extension before building any extension state; never replace old results.
scope: Union of production roots and all test/tests/testing/testsuite/_tests directories plus root test*.py files across target, tips and native integration; exact same include list and environment for every state. Stub-dependent, non-UTF8, unparsable, external missing-dependency, incomplete and ambiguous states remain unlabelled.
mapping: Exact identity subtraction after explicit one-to-one Git rename path mapping. Occurrence is a location-free AST expression plus lexical scope. Repeated indistinguishable sites and shadowed import bindings are ambiguous. Root cause binds the checker rule, symbol, scope and defining AST/context; no error-count/message subtraction.
eligibility: All tip deltas are empty; integrated new supported diagnostic absent from every tip is positive, no new diagnostic is control; new unsupported or uncertain evidence is unlabelled. Minimality uses presence of the same diagnostic delta, not checker exit status.
publication: Development-only baseline-relative stratum, never a holdout or release gate; no historical exclusion relabelled. Whole corpus attempted/excluded counts, every FP/FN and unlabelled shares are retained. Zero findings/positives never passes a gate.
